claim: Minimizing an upper bound on mutual information between messages and senders' observations reduces the uncertainty (entropy) of messages.
falsifier: One can implement a multi-agent communication system with a regularizer that minimizes an upper bound on mutual information between messages and observations, and measure the entropy of the resulting messages to verify reduction.

conditions: The upper bound is established as part of a regularized method
The method is applied to reduce redundant information in communication
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the IMAC method and its reported experimental conditions; transfer beyond those settings is unestablished.

title: Minimizing an upper bound for uncertainty of messages
